description: A small settlement (vicus) associated with the fort at Caersws. Some early dating evidence from the late 1st CE, but the primary period of activity appears to be the mid 2nd and into the 3rd CE. One of the buildings identified was interpreted as a Romano-Celtic Temple enclosed by a palisade, to the north of the building a figurine of Venus was found in a rubbish pit.
